notes: v4: trained on ROI crops — the app MUST crop with the same MediaPipe palm-ROI logic before embedding. See MediaPipeHandDetector.palmRoiFrom + PalmPreprocessor._cropPalmRoi, which reproduce the training crop exactly (landmarks 0,1,2,5,9,13,17; centre = mean; half = 1.1 x dist(wrist, middle_mcp); square clipped to bounds; centre-square fallback when no hand is detected).

THRESHOLD IS 0.70 (INTERIM, set 2026-07-28) — not the v4 eval value 0.5084, and not FAR-derived despite the field name. Measured on-device with v4 + ROI crop, 2 real people: genuine 0.7593 / 0.8437; live impostor ~0.63; cross-person enrolled templates 0.5696. 0.5084 sat BELOW the entire impostor range, i.e. the palm layer accepted anyone. 0.70 separates this sample but margins are thin (genuine 0.7593 clears by 0.06) and it is fitted to n=2 — expect false rejects on other people. Re-derive from 10+ identities before widening the pilot. Do NOT lower it toward 0.5084 without new evidence.
The SERVER decides. Firestore config/model overrides this file, so the live threshold is whatever that doc says — check there first when the numbers look wrong.

PILOT ONLY — not a standalone security gate. Measured on two real people: false rejects 14% -> 0%, false accepts 29% -> 14%. Acceptable as ONE layer alongside the Wi-Fi fingerprint and session window, under supervision, on 1-2 sections.

v4 changes the embedding space: templates enrolled under any earlier model_version are NOT comparable and must be re-enrolled. submitAttendance rejects cross-version comparisons rather than scoring them.
INT8 deferred — corrupts this backbone (~0.70 self-cosine). Use fp32 mobile / fp16 web.
CLAHE is train-time augmentation only; do NOT apply at inference.
Enroll = mean of L2-normalized embeddings from several frames, then re-normalize.
NEVER compare single-shot embeddings — always use averaged templates.
Store hand_side explicitly; gate left/right before comparing.
palm_fp16_web.onnx (see models.web) is for a separate web client — it is not bundled into this Flutter app's assets (not referenced in pubspec.yaml).
